title: The Hat on the Run
description: Three pals, one hat, and a nosy duck.
script:
story 2
variable net = false hidden
scene anne-garden
show Anna curious left
show Anne happy center
show Diana happy right
camera wide cut
I: Anna is back. Her pals wave.
react Anne wave
Anne [happy]: Come on! A picnic for us!
scene anne-windy-path
show Anna curious left
show Anne happy center
show Diana happy right
camera wide cut
Diana [surprised]: The wind has your hat!
Anne [surprised]: My hat can fly!
choice chase
option hop "Hop, hop!" -> hop
option flap "Flap your arms!" -> flap
label hop
move Anna bounce
Anna [happy]: Hop! I am a frog!
Anne [laughing]: A frog can help!
goto bush
label flap
react Anna excited
Anna [happy]: Flap! I am a duck!
Anne [laughing]: A duck can help!
goto bush
label bush
scene anne-hat-bush
show Anna curious left
show Anne happy center
show Diana happy right
camera wide cut
Diana [curious]: It is stuck in a bush.
Anne [laughing]: A duck wants it for a nest!
choice tool
option net "Get a net." -> net ; net = true
option stick "Get a stick." -> stick
label net
react Anna reach
Anna [happy]: Up goes the net. Got it!
Diana [relieved]: Good catch! No mud on it.
goto safe
label stick
react Anna reach
Anna [happy]: Tap, tap. Down it drops!
Diana [laughing]: Plop! A spot of mud!
goto safe
label safe
scene anne-hat-safe
show Anna curious left
show Anne happy center
show Diana happy right
camera wide cut
Anne [relieved]: My hat is safe. Thank you!
Diana [happy]: Now we can sit and eat.
Anne [excited]: Our pals need a club name!
choice club
option hat "The Hat Club!" -> hatclub
option duck "The Duck Club!" -> duckclub
label hatclub
react Anne bow
Anne [proud]: Hats off to our club!
Diana [laughing]: Hold on to that hat!
goto toolcheck
label duckclub
react Anna laugh
Anna [laughing]: Quack! A club of ducks!
Diana [laughing]: We can quack and eat buns!
goto toolcheck
label toolcheck
if net == true -> netend else stickend
label netend
Anna [happy]: A net, a hat, and my pals.
goto end
label stickend
Anna [happy]: A stick, a hat, and my pals.
goto end
label end
Anne [happy]: A grand day with you, Anna!
end
notice: A new make-believe visit to the world of Anne of Green Gables by L. M. Montgomery. These visits and words are newly written, not scenes or quotations from the book.

Anna.name: Anna
Anna.provenance: Storybook adaptation for Chunky Reader; shared polished SVG builder, not a likeness.

Anne.name: Anne
Anne.provenance: Original stylized book adaptation of Anne Shirley: red hair, imaginative and eager for friendship. Not based on an actor or screen adaptation.

Diana.name: Diana
Diana.provenance: Original stylized book adaptation of Diana Barry: dark hair, warm and practical. Not based on an actor or screen adaptation.
